verdict.rationale: Sentry documents REST API endpoints (e.g., bulk issue mutation, events API) and an official MCP server/CLI for AI-native workflows, showing broad but not fully verified parity with the UI. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec is discoverable (probe shows 404s), and API/MCP access is gated behind paid plans, suggesting incomplete or restricted parity rather than full UI-equivalent API coverage. Missing for 10: a comprehensive OpenAPI spec, explicit documentation confirming 1:1 UI/API feature parity, and evidence that all UI actions (e.g., dashboard creation, alert configuration) are exposed via API without plan restrictions.
